songs.title: up on my toes
songs.description: Warm soul pop for a cafe, B flat major, 99 BPM. Female low alto, half voice, near speech, as if humming to herself. Narrow melody in a fourth, one phrase returning; the chorus keeps those notes and lifts because the band opens, not because she pushes; lines end early. Rounded consonants, almost no vibrato. Full band, dense and soft: tape electric piano, four-note motif, struck short; a second piano in short answers; one harmony voice, last chorus, no choir; thumb-muted bass in short eighths; soft kit, brushed snare, cabasa every bar, never dropping out. Harmony Bbmaj9 - Gm9 - Ebmaj9 - Gbmaj7 - Abmaj7 to Bbmaj9, rising home from the flat six. Vocals behind the band, blended in, not upfront. Warm tone, softened top, tape warmth, lo-fi. Ends on a plucked chord, about two and a half minutes, the lyric filling all of it. One note per syllable, the band carrying every lift. No melisma, no sustained high notes, no head voice, no saxophone, no smoky bar or lounge, no autotune, no pop gloss.

Narrow melody in a fourth, one phrase returning; the chorus keeps those notes and lifts because the band opens, not because she pushes; lines end early. Rounded consonants, almost no vibrato. Full band, dense and soft: electric grand, four-note motif, struck short; chorused Rhodes in short off-beat chords; one harmony voice, last chorus, no choir; picked bass in pushing eighths; soft kit, snare, cabasa every bar, never dropping out. Harmony Amaj9 - F#m9 - Dm9 - G9 to Amaj9, home by the back door, minor four to flat seven. Vocals behind the band, blended in, not upfront. Warm tone, softened top, tape warmth, lo-fi. Ends on a plucked chord, about two and a half minutes, the lyric filling all of it. One note per syllable, the band carrying every lift. No melisma, no sustained high notes, no head voice, no saxophone, no smoky bar or lounge, no autotune, no pop gloss.
